verdicts.note: The direction holds, but the evidence for 'invest & expand' is thin. It is one operational request for a backup employee, plus a remark that an observer space would help but has no funding, and both are framed as constraints ("limited budget flexibility") [S3, S2]. Her own statement calls fiscal accountability "one of our most essential responsibilities" [S1], and in 2022 she welcomed technology that would save the county "manpower and dollars" [S4]. Placing her on spending is an indirect inference, so low confidence fits better than medium.
